MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Job Description:

Join an Organisation where we Serve Something Greater; See Something Greater; and Strive for Something Greater!

ABOUT YOUR NEW ROLE:

Lead with Purpose as our Nurse Unit Manager (NUM)- Orthopaedic - Permanent Full Time

An exciting opportunity has become available for an experienced and inspiring Nurse Unit Manager (NUM) to join St Vincent's Private Hospital Melbourne (SVPHM) on a permanent full-time basis at our East Melbourne campus.

As the Nurse Unit Manager, you will provide strong clinical and operational leadership, driving excellence in patient care while fostering a positive, high-performing team culture. You will lead and mentor a dedicated nursing team, champion continuous improvement, and work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams to ensure outstanding patient outcomes.

This is an excellent opportunity for a passionate nursing leader who is committed to empowering others, delivering high-quality, patient-centred care, and making a lasting impact on both patients and staff.

If you are ready to take the next step in your leadership career, we would love to hear from you.
 

WHY WORK FOR SVPHM:

You will join a high performing team and a workplace with relationships built on mutual trust and respect. We value our staff and offer professional advancement in a respectful, collaborative and learning environment.

Join the St Vincent's Health Australia Group, and work for a truly values based organisation, who operate across VIC, NSW and QLD

Salary packaging available (pay less tax and increase your take home pay!)

Gain access to discounted gym membership through Fitness Passport

Option to join our workplace giving program, Give4Good

A great work life balance with options to purchase additional leave

Receive a staff discount on hospital admissions to any SVHA Private Hospital

ABOUT YOU:

You are an experienced and inspiring nursing leader who is passionate about delivering exceptional patient care and supporting the growth and development of your team. You lead by example, communicate with confidence, and thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced healthcare environment.

To be successful in this role, you will have:

Current registration with AHPRA as a Registered Nurse.

Demonstrated leadership experience as a Nurse Unit Manager, Associate Nurse Unit Manager, or in a similar senior nursing leadership role.

Proven ability to lead, motivate and develop high-performing nursing teams while fostering a positive workplace culture.

Excellent clinical knowledge with a strong commitment to patient safety, quality improvement and evidence-based practice.

Exceptional communication, interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build strong relationships across multidisciplinary teams.

Sound operational, workforce and resource management skills, including experience managing budgets, staffing and service delivery.

A commitment to continuous improvement and achieving outstanding patient and staff outcomes.

A genuine passion for living St Vincent's values and delivering compassionate, person-centred care.

ABOUT ST VINCENTS PRIVATE HOSPITAL MELBOURNE
Our experienced team of clinical professionals, care givers and support staff are equipped to provide the highest level of therapeutic, medical and surgical services. We work together to ensure patient safety, well-being and recovery. We are a not for profit Catholic private hospital which operates across four sites at Fitzroy, East Melbourne, Kew and Werribee.

APPLY NOW!
If this is the role for you, please hit the APPLY button now! Your application must include:

Cover Letter

Resume

We are committed to equal employment opportunity, ethical practices, the principles of cultural diversity and promote a smoke free work environment.

St Vincent's Health Australia is committed to reconciliation and encourages Aboriginal & Torres Strait Islander people to apply for all advertised positions. For further information, visit https:--www.svha.org.au-about-us-reconciliation or get in contact at indigenouscareers@svha.org.au.

REQUIREMENTS:
Criminal record and-or child protection checks will be conducted and will form part of the selection criteria for this role.

SVPHM has a duty of care under work health and safety legislation to eliminate and-or control the risk of transmission of vaccine preventable diseases (VPD) in healthcare settings. You are therefore required to comply with the SVHA Staff Health Screening Immunisation Policy, which, depending on the role you perform in the organisation will require you to undergo mandatory immunisations-vaccinations.

HAVE A QUESTION AND WANT TO KNOW MORE:
If you would like to discuss this opportunity please contact Leanne Rowlands-General Manager-Director of Clinical Services on leanne.rowlands@svha.org.au

result.description: Rocky 1 Pty Ltd           The Housekeeping Manager is responsible for leading the Housekeeping department to ensure all guest rooms, public areas, and back-of-house spaces are maintained to the highest standards of cleanliness, presentation, and safety. This role oversees daily operations, staff performance, training, rostering, inventory management, and quality control. The Housekeeping Manager plays a key leadership role in delivering exceptional guest experiences, driving departmental efficiency, and fostering a positive, professional, and service-focused team culture.   Benefits  An attractive full-time opportunity offering a competitive salary, a supportive team culture.   Task & responsibilities  KEY RESPONSIBILITIES   Leadership & Department Management   • Lead, motivate, and support the Housekeeping team to achieve high standards of cleanliness and service.   • Oversee daily operations, ensuring all rooms and public areas are serviced within required timeframes.   • Conduct daily briefings, communicating priorities, events, VIP arrivals, and operational updates.   • Manage rosters, leave requests, and staffing levels to meet business demands.   • Support recruitment, onboarding, and performance management of Housekeeping staff.   Quality Assurance & Inspections   • Conduct regular inspections of guest rooms, public areas, and back-of-house spaces.   • Ensure all cleaning standards, presentation guidelines, and brand requirements are consistently met.   • Identify areas requiring corrective action and ensure follow-up is completed promptly.   • Oversee spring-cleaning, deep-cleaning, and preventative maintenance schedules. Guest Experience   • Respond to guest feedback, requests, and concerns professionally and promptly.   • Coordinate special requests, VIP amenities, and room preferences with relevant departments.   • Work closely with Front Office to ensure accurate room status communication and smooth operations.   • Monitor guest satisfaction scores and implement improvements where required. Maintenance, Security & Compliance   • Report maintenance issues promptly and follow up to ensure timely resolution.   • Ensure Lost Property procedures are followed, documented, and securely managed.   • Maintain strict control of master keys and access protocols.   • Ensure compliance with all hotel policies, WHS requirements, and legislative obligations. We are seeking an experienced  Office Manager  to take responsibility for the day-to-day running of our accounting practice. This is a hands-on operational role suited to someone who can manage office administration, client service workflows, internal systems, staff coordination and practice support functions in a busy professional services environment.   About the Role   The Office Manager will be responsible for ensuring the office operates efficiently and that our accountants, bookkeepers and support staff have the administrative systems, resources and workflow support required to deliver timely and accurate client services.  This role requires strong office management experience, excellent organisation, confidence supervising administrative work, and the ability to manage confidential client and business information in a professional accounting practice.   Key Responsibilities   The successful applicant will be responsible for:   Managing the day-to-day operations of the accounting office, including reception, administration, client service support and office workflow.  Coordinating client onboarding, engagement documentation, appointment scheduling, document collection and follow-up procedures.  Managing office systems for client records, correspondence, lodgement tracking, document storage, workflow monitoring and internal reporting.  Supporting accountants and bookkeepers with administrative coordination for tax returns, BAS, bookkeeping, ASIC, payroll and business compliance work.  Allocating tasks to administrative support staff and monitoring completion, quality, deadlines and service standards.  Reviewing office procedures and implementing practical improvements to improve efficiency, accuracy and client response times.  Liaising with clients, accountants, bookkeepers, suppliers, software providers and external advisers to resolve administrative and operational matters.  Managing office resources, including software subscriptions, supplies, office equipment, stationery, facilities and service provider arrangements.  Maintaining supplier records, invoices, office accounts, subscription registers and other administrative financial records.  Coordinating staff administration, including onboarding support, leave records, training coordination, timesheets and payroll administration support.  Assisting management with recruitment administration, staff scheduling, performance documentation and internal policy implementation.  Supporting compliance with privacy requirements, workplace procedures, occupational health and safety obligations and internal practice standards.  Preparing management reports, administrative updates and workflow summaries for the Director.  Ensuring the office environment remains organised, professional, confidential and client-focused.    Skills and Experience   To be considered for this role, applicants should have:   Previous experience as an Office Manager, Practice Manager, Administration Manager, Senior Administrator or similar.  Experience in an accounting, taxation, bookkeeping, finance, legal or other professional services office will be highly regarded.  Strong knowledge of office administration, workflow coordination, document management and staff task allocation.  Ability to supervise administrative work and ensure deadlines are met.  Excellent written and verbal communication skills.  High attention to detail and strong ability to handle confidential information.  Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office and cloud-based business systems.  Experience using accounting practice software, client management systems or document management platforms will be highly regarded.  Ability to work independently, solve operational problems and manage competing priorities.  Professional presentation and a client-focused approach.    Qualifications   Relevant qualifications in business administration, management, accounting administration or a related field will be highly regarded.  Applicants with substantial relevant office management or professional services administration experience are also encouraged to apply.   Why Join Us?    Full-time role with a professional accounting and taxation practice.  Opportunity to manage and improve office operations.  Work closely with accountants, bookkeepers and business services professionals.  Support a client-focused practice servicing individuals, families and small businesses.  Stable role with responsibility across administration, systems, workflow and staff coordination.
